name: Ai no Hanadayori
source:
Why not step into a gentle, softly drawn, hand-painted fairy tale world?

Liel is a gardener in the Kingdom of Amestaria, the city of flowers.
This story follows her romantic journey with Mios, the first prince of Amestaria.
